bands.derivation_rule: Tolerance is a fraction of R's per-level statistic, chosen a priori from R's own dispersion (per-parcel p50/p90 spread in density.json; parcel count per level) before any run on G. 0.25 where R has >=1000 parcels with roads (L0, L2, L4); 0.35 at L6/L8 (200 and 40 parcels, so R's own statistic is noisier). Shares use a fractional tolerance with an absolute floor so rare classes are not over-constrained. Never adjusted after seeing G. R numbers: profile/bands_derivation.json.

vertices_per_link.basis: R per-parcel p90/p50 spread is 2-7x; the level aggregate is much tighter, so a quarter of R (looser at sparse L6/L8) bounds the aggregate.

vertices_per_km.basis: Aggregate over hundreds to tens of thousands of parcels; same dispersion basis as vertices_per_link.

road_type_share.basis: Class shares are census fractions over 1e4-1e7 links; a quarter of R's share allows generalisation differences, floor covers rare classes.

background_type_share.basis: Census fractions over 25 to 9.4M shapes; floor covers rare types.

background_count.basis: Tightened from the 0.5x-2x envelope to +-50% for Phase 7's per-class census; OSM coverage of reserves/water legitimately differs from survey data.

link_flag_prevalence.statistic: True share of each road.link_flag_hists flag over link_count, profile/map.json
link_flag_prevalence.basis: Flag prevalences are census fractions; floor 0.01 absolute for near-zero flags (toll ~1e-4).

node_bit_prevalence.statistic: share of oneway / pseudo3d_updown values in link_flag_hists (per node), profile/map.json
node_bit_prevalence.basis: Same basis as link flags, over node_count.

name_type_mix.statistic: share of name.string_type_hist and name.type_code_hist, profile/map.json levels[L]
name_type_mix.basis: Census fractions over 8 to 19M records; mix is the Phase 8 outcome.

name_record_distance_tolerance.statistic: Phase 2 overlay: distance between decoded R records and OSM match, as fraction of cell extent
name_record_distance_tolerance.basis: R quantises to a 4096 (or 16384) grid per cell; half a percent of the cell is ~20 grid units, above quantisation and OSM-vs-survey offset yet far below cluster scale.

vocab_coverage.statistic: fraction of R's vocabulary values (road_type, display_class, background type, name string/type), weighted by R frequency, that G must use
vocab_coverage.basis: The last 5% of R's frequency mass may be absent from an OSM-sourced G; anything more common must appear (consumed by 1-04).

review.reviewer: read-only Explore research helper (independent, given only bands and R numbers)
objections: 1 tolerances (0.25/0.35) not derived from measured noise
2 L6/L8 per-parcel skew: 0.35 likely too tight at 40 parcels
3 floor 0.01 exceeds R share for rare classes (unconstrained); no presence/absence check
4 relative 0.25 vacuous on dominant shares (L4-L8 class 2 at 0.90-0.98)
6 name-mix floor 0.02 swamps small codes; L8 has 209 name records; L10/L12 have 8 records/25 shapes
7 constant flags (0.0 or 1.0 in R) get 0.01 slack
8 background_count +-50% loose at L0 and same for L10/L12
9 missing quantities (p90 vertices per link, length distribution, degree, etc.)
10 vertices per link and per km correlated
11 frequency-weighted coverage cannot catch rare structural classes
review.resolution: Amendments recorded a priori (no G run): (3,5) add histogram_l1 <= 0.25 (0.35 at L6/L8) over each share histogram and require any class with R share >= 0.5% to be present in G; (4) dominant shares (R >= 0.9) are bounded via the complement, |G-R| <= 0.25*(1-R) when applicable; (7) flags constant in R (0.0/1.0) must match exactly; (6,8) L10 and L12 (<=25 shapes, 8 name records) are exempt from share and count bands and require exact vocabulary match; (11) coverage additionally requires every R class with share >= 1% at that level to appear. Not adopted: (1,2) tolerances are judgment values, not bootstrapped; L6/L8 left at 0.35 with the L1 rule as backstop, because bootstrapping was out of budget and bands may not be tuned on G; (9,10) added quantities deferred, would need a design change. Orchestrator confirmation pending; not marked accepted.

amendments.constant_flags: exact match when R prevalence is 0.0 or 1.0
